decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the feed for genuine backpacks, filtering out the irrelevant camping gear like tents and air mattresses. My consideration set includes a high-rated packable daypack (HIKPRO), an insulated hydration pack (Mubasel), a durable EDC bag (Maxpedition), an affordable laptop bag (KAUKKO), and a rugged canvas rucksack (Fox Outdoor). I chose the HIKPRO 20L because it has an exceptional rating of 4.7 with a high review count, offering the best balance of portability, durability, and value for a general-purpose daypack.
